reading:
AiNET was established in 1993 and is based in Beltsville, Maryland. The company is led by President Deepak Jain, who began his career as an information systems specialist for the National Security Agency, and Vice President of Business Development Darrell Tanno. AiNET provides IT solutions and colocation services to enterprises and federal government agencies.

The company's most distinctive facility, CyberNAP in Glen Burnie, Maryland, is a converted former department store attached to a suburban mall, a 300,000 square foot, three-story structure with 20-foot ceilings and heavy-duty floor supports repurposed for data center use. Scheduled to open in July 2012 as AiNET's third data center location, it offers capacity for up to 10,000 server cabinets, dual utility power feeds, and 1,500 parking spaces available for customer container deployment, along with multiple security zones built to SCIF standards for federal agencies. Its location near Fort Meade, home to the NSA and Department of Defense DISA operations, aligns with AiNET's federal government customer focus.

The registry here tracks 2 AiNET facilities, both in Maryland, consistent with the company's Beltsville and Glen Burnie area concentration. AiNET's federal-security specialization and its adaptive reuse of a retail building into a data center are distinct patterns not seen among the larger hyperscale and colocation operators recorded elsewhere in this registry.

sources.title: Data Center Knowledge, AiNET to Convert Department Store into CyberNAP
